decisionsTaken: Same box size, typography, gap, color.choice.* colors and focus ring as Checkbox; circle (radius.full) with a dot of 3/8 of the box.
size, readonly and invalid are states inherited from the group, not props of the radio; disabled exists on both.
The size is a state inherited from the group: per-size custom properties are chosen from data-size; the selection is read from the item data-state through :has().

Implementation review, round 1 (user, 2026-10-27): the field border was too contrasted; color.field.default.border in light moved to the new primitive step neutral.450 (3.43:1, still at least 3:1), hover to neutral.500; readonly and the off borders of checkbox, radio and switch follow (foundations change recorded in foundations/tokens/status.json pendingChanges).

Implementation review, round 1 (user, 2026-10-27: selected dots flattened or off-center, outer circles odd): ring and dot are drawn as SVG circles (ring stroke inside the box, dot 3/8 of the box), centered by SVG geometry instead of CSS boxes snapped to device pixels at fractional display scales.
Field border contrast: option A kept, the light border on neutral.450 at 3.43:1 (user, 2026-10-27: "tu peux rester sur cette valeur de contour"); styles may be adjusted at the global visual pass.
